surviving_distinction: AuthorityCone is proposed as a monotone feasible-action geometry upstream of effect-bearing GWT and proactive goal action synthesis, with non-authority cognition allowed only to contract/intersect the region. This distinction has not yet been shown to outperform an early use of the existing deterministic EffectGate plus ordinary constraint propagation.
